# Test fixtures

| Item | What it is |
|---|---|
| `demo/` | The demo's six files and `script.json`, the scripted turns of the demo question |
| `parsing/` | Small files for each basic parser, and a corrupt PDF |
| `samples.json` | One sample of each wire model and event, checked against `contract/schema.json` |
| `fake_cli.py` | A stand-in for a headless CLI, for the command runtime's tests |
